title: Code of Conduct and Business Ethics Policy
objective: To set out how everyone at Zenvora is expected to behave towards customers, colleagues, partners and the company, so that decisions can be made without a rulebook for every case.
applies_to: All employees (all bands), interns, consultants and contractors working for Zenvora.

title: Hybrid Work Policy
objective: To give people flexibility on where they work while keeping enough time together in the office for collaboration, mentoring and customer-facing work.
applies_to: All full-time employees. Interns follow the on-site rules for Z1. Consultants follow their contract.

title: Leave Policy
objective: To explain the types and amounts of leave, how to apply, and how leave is treated when employment ends.
applies_to: All full-time employees. Interns receive leave as stated in their offer letter.

title: Progressive Discipline Policy
objective: To provide a fair, structured process for correcting conduct, performance and attendance issues, consistent with Zenvora's values and employment law.
applies_to: All employees (all bands), consultants and contractors working for Zenvora.

title: Acceptable Use and Electronic Communication Policy
objective: To explain what is acceptable when using Zenvora's devices, email, chat, internet and approved AI tools, and how the company monitors usage.
applies_to: All employees, interns, consultants and vendors using Zenvora systems, networks or accounts.

title: Information Security Policy
objective: To protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of Zenvora's and its customers' information, and to meet ISO 27001, SOC 2 and applicable law including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
applies_to: All employees, interns, consultants, contractors and partners with access to Zenvora information.

title: Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) Policy
objective: To provide safe and healthy working conditions at every Zenvora location and to reduce the company's environmental footprint.
applies_to: All employees, interns, consultants, contractors and visitors at Zenvora premises or acting on behalf of Zenvora.

title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy
objective: To prevent sexual harassment and to provide a safe, confidential and fair process to deal with complaints, as required by the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. Zenvora extends the same protection to employees of every gender.
applies_to: Everyone who works for or with Zenvora, in every location, including interns, consultants, contractors and visitors, and also covering events, travel and online interaction.

title: Performance Management and Appraisal Policy
objective: To set clear goals, give regular feedback, rate performance fairly and link pay, promotion and development to performance.
applies_to: All employees confirmed or on probation with at least 3 months in the cycle.

title: Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy
objective: To reimburse reasonable business expenses promptly and consistently, and to keep travel spend within budget.
applies_to: All employees travelling or spending on behalf of Zenvora.

title: Backend Engineering Standards and Code Review Policy
objective: To keep backend services reliable, secure and easy to change through consistent engineering practice.
applies_to: All engineers who change backend code or services.

title: Frontend and Mobile Release and Accessibility Policy
objective: To ship web and mobile changes predictably, accessibly and without crashing customers' phones.
applies_to: All engineers and designers shipping Pulse web and mobile apps.

title: Data Governance and Responsible AI Policy
objective: To use data lawfully and carefully, and to release AI features only when they are accurate, safe and honest about being AI.
applies_to: All employees and contractors who work with customer or company data or build AI features.

title: Quality Gates and Release Sign-off Policy
objective: To make release decisions based on evidence agreed in advance.
applies_to: All production releases of Zenvora products.

title: Cloud Operations, On-call and Incident Management Policy
objective: To keep production available and recoverable, and to learn from every incident.
applies_to: All engineers who deploy to or operate production, and incident participants.

title: Product Development Lifecycle and Design Review Policy
objective: To decide what to build based on customer evidence, and to launch features that Support and Sales are ready for.
applies_to: Product managers, designers and anyone proposing product changes.

title: Sales Discounts, Contracts and Marketing Communications Policy
objective: To win business honestly, protect margins and keep contracts and communications compliant.
applies_to: Everyone who quotes, sells, signs or markets Zenvora products.

title: Support Operations, Shift and SLA Policy
objective: To answer customers quickly and consistently, with fair shifts and safe working conditions.
applies_to: All Customer Support employees and partner BPO agents working on Zenvora queues.

title: Asset Management and Access Control Policy
objective: To keep a trustworthy inventory of devices and to give people the access they need and nothing more.
applies_to: All employees, contractors and anyone issued a Zenvora device or account.
